categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Siglent Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of general electronic test and measurement instruments. Its primary product lines include digital oscilloscopes, waveform and signal generators, spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, power supplies, multimeters, and electronic loads. The company also provides related solutions and operates globally with subsidiaries in the US, Germany, and Japan.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-bandwidth low-noise oscilloscope front-end circuits, high waveform refresh rate digital signal processing, high sampling rate DDS signal generation, real-time spectrum analysis, and integrated vector network analysis. It employs modular hardware and software platform designs, digital signal processing algorithms, and FPGA-based measurement functions. Production focuses on software burning, functional testing, and assembly quality control, with outsourcing of PCB assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Siglent serves a broad range of customers in electronics research and development, production testing, field maintenance, and education. Its products are widely used in communications, semiconductors, automotive electronics, medical electronics, consumer electronics, government agencies, and academic research. The company’s global customer base spans over 80 countries and regions, with significant sales in domestic China and overseas markets including North America, Europe, Japan, and emerging markets in Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily from its headquarters in Shenzhen, China, with wholly owned subsidiaries in the United States (Cleveland), Germany (Augsburg), and Japan (Tokyo). It also has branch offices in major Chinese cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Wuhan, and Nanjing. Its products and services cover more than 80 countries worldwide, with a growing overseas revenue proportion of over 60%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Siglent operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the electronic test equipment supply chain. It focuses on product development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales services. The company outsources PCB assembly but retains core technology development, software, testing, and final assembly in-house, positioning itself as a technology-driven manufacturer and global distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation and high R&D investment, focusing on advancing high-end product capabilities such as 8 GHz bandwidth 12-bit high-resolution oscilloscopes, 40 GHz RF microwave signal generators, and 26.5 GHz spectrum and vector network analyzers. It emphasizes core technology self-control, algorithm development, modular hardware/software platforms, and expanding product applications. Siglent aims to enhance global market share, strengthen brand influence, and achieve import substitution in mid-to-high-end segments.
categories.revenue_model: Siglent generates revenue primarily through the sale of electronic test and measurement instruments via multiple channels including distributors, direct sales, and ODM partnerships. The company’s revenue is product-based, with sales recognized upon transfer of control to customers. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue stream is product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with leading international electronic test equipment manufacturers such as Keysight Technologies, Tektronix, Teledyne LeCroy, and Rohde & Schwarz. Siglent is one of the few global firms with full capabilities across the four main product lines and is recognized as a domestic technology leader in China. It positions itself as a cost-effective alternative with comparable or superior performance to international peers, focusing on high-end product innovation and global market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Siglent achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 483.2 million, a 21.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 155.3 million, up 10.3%. The company’s gross margin improved to 61.3%. R&D expenses increased by 49.4% to RMB 86.1 million, accounting for 17.8% of revenue. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.66 billion with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Siglent emphasizes high-performance, high-resolution, and high-bandwidth electronic test instruments with advanced digital signal processing and modular design. Its products offer superior measurement accuracy, low noise, high refresh rates, and rich functionality at competitive prices. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and global marketing network provide customers with reliable, innovative, and cost-effective solutions, supporting diverse application scenarios and enhancing customer loyalty.
